summary.text: PAUDBLOD is a batch IMS DL/I load utility (run by LOADPADB.JCL as BMP with PSB PSBPAUTB) that reloads the pending authorization database from the two sequential files produced by PAUDBUNL. It first reads every summary record from INFILE1 and inserts it as a PAUTSUM0 root, tolerating duplicates ('II'). It then reads every record of INFILE2 (packed account id plus detail); for records with a numeric account key it positions on the parent root with a qualified GU (ACCNTID EQ key) and inserts the PAUTDTL1 child, again tolerating duplicates. Open failures and unexpected insert statuses end the run with RETURN-CODE 16.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.logic: Entered via ENTRY 'DLITCBL' using PAUTBPCB; displays 'STARTING PAUDBLOD', initializes, loads all root records until END-ROOT-SEG-FILE = 'Y', then all child records until END-CHILD-SEG-FILE = 'Y', closes the files and GOBACKs.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.logic: Accepts and displays the current date, then opens INFILE1 and INFILE2 for input; a status other than spaces/'00' displays the error and performs 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 2000-READ-ROOT-SEG-FILE
paragraphs.logic: Reads INFILE1; on success moves the record to PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY and inserts it. Status '10' sets END-ROOT-SEG-FILE = 'Y'; any other status only displays 'ERROR READING ROOT SEG INFILE' and continues.

paragraphs.name: 2100-INSERT-ROOT-SEG
paragraphs.logic: Calls CBLTDLI ISRT with ROOT-UNQUAL-SSA (PAUTSUM0) on PAUTBPCB. Blank status displays 'ROOT INSERT SUCCESS', 'II' displays 'ROOT SEGMENT ALREADY IN DB', any other status displays 'ROOT INSERT FAILED' and performs 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 3000-READ-CHILD-SEG-FILE
paragraphs.logic: Reads INFILE2; on success and when ROOT-SEG-KEY is numeric moves it to QUAL-SSA-KEY-VALUE, moves CHILD-SEG-REC to PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS and performs 3100-INSERT-CHILD-SEG. Status '10' sets END-CHILD-SEG-FILE = 'Y'; other statuses only display 'ERROR READING CHILD SEG INFILE'.

paragraphs.name: 3100-INSERT-CHILD-SEG
paragraphs.logic: Clears the PCB status and calls CBLTDLI GU with ROOT-QUAL-SSA (PAUTSUM0 ACCNTID EQ key). Only when the status is blank does it display success and perform 3200-INSERT-IMS-CALL; the nested failure check (no END-IF on the outer IF) is evaluated only on that path, so a failed GU is ignored and the child is skipped.

paragraphs.name: 3200-INSERT-IMS-CALL
paragraphs.logic: Calls CBLTDLI ISRT with CHILD-UNQUAL-SSA (PAUTDTL1) under the current parent. Blank status displays success, 'II' displays 'CHILD SEGMENT ALREADY IN DB', other statuses display the failure and key feedback and perform 9999-ABEND.

paragraphs.name: 4000-FILE-CLOSE
paragraphs.logic: Closes INFILE1 and INFILE2, displaying an error for a non-'00' status (no abend).

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND
paragraphs.logic: Displays 'IMS LOAD ABENDING ...', sets RETURN-CODE 16 and GOBACKs.

paragraphs.name: 9999-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 9999-ABEND (EXIT only, not reached).

rules.statement: A detail record from the child file is loaded only when its packed account key (ROOT-SEG-KEY) is numeric; it is inserted as a PAUTDTL1 child under the PAUTSUM0 root whose ACCNTID equals that key. Records with a non-numeric key are skipped silently.
rules.conditions: ROOT-SEG-KEY IS NUMERIC and GU on PAUTSUM0 (ACCNTID EQ key) returns blank status

rules.statement: Reloading is re-runnable: a root or child segment that already exists (IMS status 'II') is reported and skipped rather than treated as an error; any other insert failure ends the run with return code 16.
rules.anchor: IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'II'

rules.statement: An input file that cannot be opened ends the run with return code 16; read errors other than end of file are only displayed and processing continues.

observations.text: In 3100-INSERT-CHILD-SEG the IF on line 305 has no END-IF, so the 'ROOT GU CALL FAIL' check on line 310 is nested inside the success branch and never sees a failed GU; a detail whose parent root is missing ('GE') is silently dropped.
A READ error other than '10' only displays a message without setting the end flag; a persistent error status would loop indefinitely.

ENTRY 'DLITCBL' passes only PAUTBPCB while PROCEDURE DIVISION USING expects IO-PCB-MASK then PAUTBPCB; PSBPAUTB is CMPAT=YES (I/O PCB first), so if the program is entered via DLITCBL the first PCB (I/O PCB) would map to PAUTBPCB (Inferred; depends on the link-edit entry point).
The load runs in BMP mode without any CHKP calls, so a large reload is one unit of work.
PRM-INFO, checkpoint id, expiry fields and IMS-RETURN-CODE 88-levels are unused; WS-PGMNAME says 'IMSUNLOD'.

sme_questions.question: Should details whose parent summary is missing be reported (the GU failure check is unreachable)?
Which entry point is used at runtime (main entry with IO-PCB-MASK, or DLITCBL with PAUTBPCB only)?
